<security_assessment>
<decision>SAFE</decision>
<details>
This PKGBUILD follows standard AUR packaging practices. The package `alise` is described as a "Declarative Arch Linux installer in Guile Scheme." The source is fetched from Codeberg (`codeberg.org/mipi/alise`) via a standard tarball URL with a verified sha256 checksum (not SKIP). The `package()` function simply runs `make DESTDIR="$pkgdir" install`, which is the expected pattern for installing files into the staging directory. There are no `eval`, `base64`, `curl`, or `wget` commands in the build function beyond the normal source fetching. No obfuscated code, suspicious network destinations, or unexpected file operations are present. The package depends on `guile` and `guile-ssh`, which are legitimate dependencies for a Guile Scheme tool. There are no post-install hooks, system configuration changes, or backdoor mechanisms. All code and commands are consistent with ordinary packaging workflow.
</details>
